name: Wordseek Bot
description: A competitive Wordle-style Telegram game bot. Play in groups or DMs with leaderboards, daily puzzles, and more.

APP_URL.description: The public HTTPS URL of this Heroku app (no trailing slash). Enables instant webhook delivery instead of slow long-polling. Format: https://your-app-name.herokuapp.com — find your app name in the Heroku dashboard.

DAILY_WORDLE_SECRET.description: A random secret string used for daily wordle signing. Use any long random text.

DAILY_WORDLE_START_DATE.description: Start date for the daily wordle rotation in YYYY-MM-DD format.

ADMIN_USERS.description: Your Telegram User ID(s), comma-separated. Get yours from @userinfobot.

TIME_ZONE.description: Timezone for daily puzzle resets. e.g. Asia/Kolkata, America/New_York

LOGS_CHANNEL.description: Telegram channel/group ID for normal activity logs. Bot must be admin there. Leave blank to skip.

ANTICHEAT_LOGS_CHANNEL.description: Telegram channel/group ID for anti-cheat / suspicious-activity logs. Bot must be admin there. Leave blank to skip.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub Personal Access Token (repo scope) for live data persistence. Get from: GitHub > Settings > Developer Settings > Tokens (classic). Leave blank to disable.

GITHUB_OWNER.description: Your GitHub username for data persistence.

GITHUB_REPO.description: GitHub repo name for data persistence.

GITHUB_BRANCH.description: GitHub branch for data persistence. Uses 'data' branch to keep code (main) and game data separate.

GEMINI_API_KEYS.description: Comma-separated Gemini API keys for word meaning generation. Get from aistudio.google.com. Leave blank to disable.
